title: [FMLA 14] DropDistance — Distance of Drop
summary: Vertical displacement under constant g from ROM (CONST 9-3 = 9.80665).

body.text: Calculator scroll name: DropDistance. Vertical displacement under constant g from ROM (not a typed 9.8).
If you let go (no throw), v₀ is 0 and the formula collapses to s = ½ g t². Time has more effect than it first looks: double the time, four times the distance.

body.caption: Dropped from rest (v₀ = 0), ROM g = 9.80665. Distance down grows with t². At 2 s the drop is about 19.61 m.

body.title: How to run
items: Press FMLA, then 1, then 4 (or scroll to the name and EXE)

body.label: CONST / g
body.text: Uses gravitational acceleration g from ROM (not a rounded 9.8 you type yourself). v₀ in m/s, t in seconds (t > 0), s in m.
